neighbours.label: Words meaning 'more than / nearly / almost' just before a number, in French, German, Arabic or Chinese prose (plus de, presque, près de, mehr als, أكثر من, 近, 将近); the same sentence with an exact number stays lower, English 'more than / nearly' stays quiet, and Portuguese 'quase' and Italian 'più di' are weak. Side trigger: odd mid-word pieces in French prose.
neighbours.short: 'more than / nearly' before a number, non-English prose
neighbours.notes: Step-in reader of bonsai1/L34/N3570- (drop 0.09). Feeders-first: strongest feeder L33/N6844+ fires on prepositions in Romance/German prose and writes against une/un/eine. Output of this pole promotes un/une/una/eine. Test written blind from the label only; the solver's leak lines were placed by the blind author.
